data.body: Dogfood precondition and positive-control setup (UTC 2026-07-27): configured `gerrit` fetch/push remote is `https://RebarBotNava@rebar.solutions.navateam.com/a/rebar`. The deployed review bot is live and most recently posted LLM-Review +1 on merged change 985 at 2026-07-27 22:14:41 UTC. Current base is `origin/main` dcc90ced4. Routing inspection confirms `project.review-phase-boundaries` is code-review-only, `default_posture: advisory`, `block_threshold: 0.90`, and `blocking_enabled: false`. Positive-control patchset changes only Pass-1 discovery/evidence grounding: it requires the finder to isolate the shortest operative clause and explicitly name the instructed phase, assigned action, and owning phase; otherwise it abstains. It does not assign Pass-2 validity/impact, Pass-3 decision/severity/blocking, or Pass-4 coaching work.
